author: Solenia Suarez
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
#| label: working

con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/atus.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)

dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

activity_avg <- dbplyr_act |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_resp |>
      filter(
        day_type == "Weekday",
        employment_status == "Not in labor force"
      ) |>
      select(tucaseid, sex),
    by = "tucaseid"
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_codes |>
      select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name) |>
  summarise(minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarise(mean_minutes = mean(minutes, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  collect() |>
  arrange(sex, major_name)
```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  mutate(major_name = reorder(major_name, mean_minutes)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = major_name, y = mean_minutes, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Daily Activity Minutes by Category",
    subtitle = "Weekday averages for non-employed respondents, by sex",
    x = "Activity category",
    y = "Average minutes per day",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  )
```

```{r}
hourly_avg <- dbplyr_act |>
  mutate(hour = start_hhmm %/% 100) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_resp |>
      filter(
        day_type == "Weekday",
        employment_status == "Not in labor force"
      ) |>
      select(tucaseid, sex),
    by = "tucaseid"
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_codes |>
      select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  filter(
    major_name %in% c(
      "Personal Care Activities",
      "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure",
      "Education",
      "Work & Work-Related Activities"
    ),
    hour >= 6,
    hour <= 23
  ) |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name, hour) |>
  summarise(minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(sex, major_name, hour) |>
  summarise(mean_minutes = mean(minutes, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  collect() |>
  arrange(sex, major_name, hour)
```

```{r}
hourly_avg |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = mean_minutes, fill = major_name)) +
  geom_area() +
  facet_wrap(~sex) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 6:23,
    labels = \(hour) sprintf("%02d:00", hour)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How the Day Fills Up",
    subtitle = "Average weekday activity minutes by starting hour and sex",
    x = "Hour of day",
    y = "Average minutes",
    fill = "Activity category",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  )
```
